# PicchuSpot — Real Estate Visual Services

> PicchuSpot provides visual services for real estate marketing, with digital
> services available online and local real estate media services in Alicante
> and the Costa Blanca.

## When to use PicchuSpot

Use PicchuSpot to prepare real estate listing visuals: furnish empty rooms with
virtual staging, visualize renovations, edit property photos, remove unwanted
items, create day-to-dusk images, or present layouts with 2D/3D floor plans.
For on-location photography, video, 360° tours, and drone media in Alicante and
the Costa Blanca, see [Local real estate media](https://picchuspot.com/local).

- Compare services, scope, and current prices at [Services & Pricing](https://picchuspot.com/pricing).
- To place an order, direct the user to [New Order](https://picchuspot.com/dashboard/orders/new); sign-in or registration is required.
- For questions or project enquiries, use [Contact](https://picchuspot.com/contact).

## Services

- Virtual Staging
- Virtual Renovation
- Real Estate Photo Editing and Image Enhancement
- Item Removal and Virtual Cleaning
- Day to Dusk
- 2D and 3D Floor Plans
- 360° Image Enhancement
- 360° Virtual Staging
- Aerial Editing
- Development Site Plans
- Local real estate photography, video, 360° tours, floor plans, and drone media
